entries.title: II Corinthians 2:1
segments: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come again to you with sorrow.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:2
segments: For if I make you sorry, who then is he that maketh me glad but he that is made sorry by me?

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:3
segments: And I wrote this very thing, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is [the joy] of you all.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:4
segments: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be made sorry, but that ye might know the love that I have more abundantly unto you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:5
segments: But if any hath caused sorrow, he hath caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I press not too heavily) to you all.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:6
segments: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was [inflicted] by the many;

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:7
segments: so that contrariwise ye should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his overmuch sorrow.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:8
segments: Wherefore I beseech you to confirm [your] love toward him.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:9
segments: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye are obedient in all things.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:10
segments: But to whom ye forgive anything, I [forgive] also: for what I also have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, for your sakes [have I forgiven it] in the presence of Christ;

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:11
segments: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:12
segments: Now when I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ, and when a door was opened unto me in the Lord,

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:13
segments: I had no relief for my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went forth into Macedonia.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:14
segments: But thanks be unto God, who always leadeth us in triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest through us the savor of his knowledge in every place.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:15
segments: For we are a sweet savor of Christ unto God, in them that are saved, and in them that perish;

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:16
segments: to the one a savor from death unto death; to the other a savor from life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:17
segments: For we are not as the many, corrupting the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, speak we in Christ.
